description: What NSF/ANSI 42, 53 and P231 mean on portable water filters, how certified differs from tested to, and how to verify a product claim.
directAnswer: NSF/ANSI 53 covers health claims such as cysts, 42 covers taste and odor, and P231 covers microbiological purifiers. Certified means a public third-party listing for that exact model, unlike tested to.
